registration_notes: Add "savedViewColOrder.spec.js" to the Logs-Core run_files list in .github/workflows/playwright.yml (Logs-Core maps to the Logs/ folder).
rationale: Existing saved-view tests cover CRUD and apply lifecycle only (create/apply/delete in multiselect-stream.spec.js, createBuilderSavedView/applySavedViewByName helpers in logs-regression-bugs.spec.js, createAndDeleteSavedSearch in sanity.spec.js). None of them assert column ORDER after applying a saved view, which is the entire subject of this change (colOrder normalization + mergeDeep array fix). No Logs spec exists for column-order normalization, so a new spec is required. Reusable page object pm.logsPage already owns the saved-view flow (clickSavedViewsExpand/clickSavedViewByTitle/clickDeleteSavedViewButton, expectFieldInTableHeader) plus the logs table selector, so the new spec can lean on it.
